invalidJson: Invalid JSON — this won't save. You're seeing the last version that saved successfully; fix it and save again.
nameHint: The organization name players see in game. Leave it empty and a new MIO shows its raw id; an MIO that reuses a vanilla id keeps the vanilla name.
confirmDelete: Delete this MIO? (the corresponding block in common/military_industrial_organization/'<'file>.txt will be removed from export)
title: Military Industrial Organization
emptyList: No MIOs yet (you can also import a vanilla MIO file)
selectHint: Select a MIO on the left, or "+ New"
equipmentTypeHint: Space-separated equipment tokens the MIO bonuses apply to (e.g. armor light_tank). Not translated.
researchCategoriesHint: Space-separated mio_cat_tech_* research categories affected. Not translated.
iconUploadHint: PNG / JPG / DDS · 65 × 67 · auto-converted to DDS at export · sets GFX_idea_mio_<id>
iconUploadSaveFirst: Save the MIO first to upload a custom icon
conditionsNote: (collapsed by default · expand to edit trigger blocks)
traitsHeadingNote: A vanilla MIO usually has one initial_trait plus a few add_trait.
advancedFieldsNote: tree_header_text / background · other top-level keys (equipment_type / research_categories now have dedicated inputs above)
traitsEmpty: No traits yet · click "+ Add trait" to add one
traitKindHint: initial = starter trait · add = extra trait · override = overrides a trait inherited from the included template
traitAllParentsHint: comma- or space-separated parent trait tokens (prerequisites)
traitIconHint: PNG / JPG / DDS · 64 × 64 · auto-converted to DDS at export · sets GFX_idea_mio_trait_<mio>_<token>
traitIconSaveFirst: Save the MIO first to upload a per-trait icon
traitIconSetToken: Set a token first — it's the icon key
traitRawExtrasNote: JSON · preserves fields not surfaced above
